newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains lower on dull market.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains lower on dull market.

text.p: UK cash grain trading hardly got off the ground on Monday with neither side showing much interest.
"No one seems very interested in doing any business today," said one broker.
Fob and delivered prices were around one stg down from Friday with no business reported on the coaster market.

Buyers and sellers were around one stg apart with May offered at 99.50 stg and bid 98.50 stg. June buyers and sellers were one stg apart at 100 and 101 stg while Oct/Dec was bid 101 stg with sellers at 101.50.
On the delivered market feed wheat ino the Tilbury area was trading at 99 stg for Apr. Further north in Suffolk/Essex 100 stg was paid For Apr and May.
In the Avon range June traded at 101 stg.
Only one trade was reported for feed barley when 100.25 stg was paid for Apr on the south coast.
No trades were reported for milling wheat.
